_meta.purpose: Generate stylized profile images for neobrutalism portfolio using subject's face as reference. Each style creates a NEW composition and pose — not a re-styled version of the reference photo.

how_to_use.gemini_imagen3: Upload reference photo + use gemini_optimized prompt. Imagen 3 supports image-as-reference via the image_generation API with image_prompt field.
how_to_use.chatgpt_dalle3: Describe the face in detail using chatgpt_optimized prompt. DALL-E does not accept image references — rely on the detailed face description fields.
how_to_use.midjourney_v6: Use /imagine with main prompt + --cref [your_image_url] flag to lock face, then stylize freely.
how_to_use.stable_diffusion: Use IP-Adapter or InstantID + ControlNet with reference image, apply the prompt as the style directive.

prompts.main: Flat vector illustration, neobrutalism style. A South Asian man in his mid-20s with short wavy dark hair, light stubble, warm brown skin — seated at a clean minimal desk, leaning slightly forward, looking directly at camera with a calm confident expression. He wears a plain dark navy crew-neck. A laptop or keyboard sits in front of him. Style: bold 2px black outlines everywhere, zero gradients, completely flat color fills. Color palette: cobalt blue #2d6be4, amber #f59e0b, dark navy #1c293c, off-white #fbfbf9. Background is off-white with subtle 24px dot-grid pattern. Hard offset drop shadow on the figure (4px right, 4px down) in #1c293c. Poster-quality editorial illustration.
prompts.negative: No photorealism, no gradients, no bokeh, no soft shadows, no anime, no sketch lines, do NOT copy the reference photo composition

Neobrutalism art style: 2px black outlines, zero gradients, flat fills in palette #2d6be4 / #f59e0b / #1c293c / #fbfbf9. Dot-grid background (#fbfbf9). Hard 4px offset shadow in navy.
